notes.title: Major Update #4
notes.content:
[p]Hey all![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been radio silent for a while now, but we haven’t been slacking off! This patch brings a mix of [b]important fixes[/b], [b]quality-of-life polish[/b], and [b]new content[/b]. Enjoy![/p][hr][/hr][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Fixed issue where Hi-Fi could be used during blackout[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed (removed) the ability to open containers in Ellie’s room[/b] (players could soft lock the game by adding key items in those containers)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed teleportation issue[/b] – the character was teleporting in the Hallway instead of the Golden Room after being killed by Mr. Blob[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Mawie Level 3 Gate issue[/b] – the gate trigger would remain open after dying and resetting the game[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Mawie enemy bee behavior[/b] – bee now resets properly after dying and resetting the game[/p][/*][*][p][b]German localization fixes[/b] – special thanks to Markus [i]“Das M” N[/i] for going the extra mile in helping us resolve localization issues and providing additional QA![/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved PC windows interaction[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fridge Interaction (off-putting smell) polish[/b] – new animations, new text, and improved flow[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Doll Jingle Note to Tina Doll[/b] when inspecting her in the Tea Room near the piano (previously the doll jingle would not trigger after the kids’ disappearance, causing confusion)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tina plays the secret Sound event when you don't have her in your inventory[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added notification that half of a modular key[/b] is added to the inventory when spare keys are inspected[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added confirmation before Ivan confrontation[/b] – players are now asked if they want to enter the final confrontation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Tina sound when entering a secret zone[/b] - she will laugh to let you know you can inspect her or drop her[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added “Hole in the Wall” Tina secret notification[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Content[/h2][h3]🕳️Hole in the Wall[/h3][p]This new content can be accessed at any time once you have access to the Guest Hallways. It features the following:[/p][list][*][p]New lore available[/p][/*][*][p]A second conversation with [b]Henry[/b][/p][/*][*][p]A new [b]Close-Up[/b] interaction[/p][/*][*][p]A new way to [b]die[/b][/p][/*][*][p]An explanation of [b]a new mechanic[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]🕯️New Candle Mechanic[/h3][p]You can now light candles via the inventory. To do this:[/p][olist][*][p]Select a candle in your inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Select the lighter[/p][/*][*][p]A new lit candle item will be added to your inventory[/p][/*][/olist][p]This mechanic works in conjunction with the [b]Cobwebs mechanic[/b].[/p][h3]🕸️Cobweb Mechanic[/h3][p]Cobwebs can appear in specific locations within the house and may cover entire entrances. These need to be burned in order to progress.[/p][h3]✨Steam Achievements[/h3][p]We’ve added the [b]first round of achievements[/b] to the game![/p][quote][p]Note: A number of achievements are still not yet implemented. They will appear in Steam as [i]“7 hidden achievements remaining”[/i] and will be added in a future update.[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sincerely,[/b]
[i]The Scared Stupid Inc. Team[/i][/p]

notes.content: [p][b]Hey all![/b][/p][p]It’s time for another update for [i]Midnight Special[/i]![/p][p]This one focuses mostly on fixing issues, polishing existing content, and addressing a few more serious problems that slipped past us.[/p][p]First up, here are the new features:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Juke Box Player[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/ed60cd556175abb7bfd7d2b8fe0812fdfeb2140d.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Jukebox – You can now add and play vinyls you find in the game at any time[/p][/*][*][p]1 new song added: "Loaded Gun", alongside a band bio and album art[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to sit in the beanbag and listen to music (new animations)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a sound snapshot that muffles the music when outside the Rumpus Room[/p][/*][*][p]The Reload Perk is still disabled until the Weapon Update[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Family Portrait (Close-Up)[/b][/p][list][*][p]The portrait now changes dynamically based on the player's actions (e.g., finding the shotgun, the necklace, as well as sanity—all are reflected in the close-up)[/p][/*][*][p]This close-up is active when the kids and Jon Sr. are missing from the portrait, and only Shelly is visible[/p][/*][/list][p]And now, the issues (bolded = serious issues that affected gameplay):[/p][list][*][p][b]Simplified Kitchen Fridge Interaction - Player no longer needs to use the lighter to trigger the Henry Sequence[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Added snapback to organ pieces in the organ puzzle, ensuring they don't get stuck[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed guest room trigger that required the player to walk in order to trigger the Void scripted event[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed issue where having the lighter on while the run prompt appears would softlock the game[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed issue where the player could not run after dying/game over in Mawie[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed/removed the ability to drop Tina (the doll) in puzzles and closeups[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed issue where connecting a controller would make the game mouse stop functioning[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed logic puzzle issue where picking up an organ puzzle piece and placing it into a drawer would cause the organ puzzle to softlock[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse teleport issue after placing cheese[/p][/*][*][p]Computer UI localization supplement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tina teleport issue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Sarah teleport issue that caused duplication of dialogue/waking up on the couch twice[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialogue duplication (interacting with TV and then loading a game save)[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]The Scared Stupid Inc. Team[/p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/5c3580904a4d9d06b5e26f237ed11eba599276d4.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Objectives[/b] (Linked to the Salt Puzzle.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Tina the Doll hints added [/b](Salt Puzzle)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Various sound/FX improvements [/b](Documents now have sound cues when they are opened or updated.)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Localization:[/b][/p][p]We've added 4 new languages[/p][list][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes/Polish:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Pick-up items and documents pop-ups should be more consistent and should notify the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Various localization issues have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Tina the Doll polish.[/p][/*][*][p]Various sound/FX issues fixed/polished.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Known issues we're working on:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Currently, if you interact with the TV and then load a save, a piece of dialogue repeats itself after load — we're currently looking into fixing this.[/p][/*][*][p]Some players may occasionally encounter repeated dialogue text in the Golden Room. We’ve identified the cause and will fix it in the next update.[/p][/*][*][p]There is also a known issue where, after interacting with Tina the Doll, she may not disappear, and the diary you receive may not show up in the inventory. notes.title: Let the porting commence!
notes.content:
In the next couple of weeks, we’ll be taking a look at porting Midnight Special to the Steam Deck. 

Most of the work is already done; however, we still need to add special UI elements (QTEs) for controller support and ensure there are no edge case issues or crashes. 

Thankfully, we’ve enlisted the help of Houdini, the port-savvy cat—so let’s all place our trust in her capable paws.

notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.content:
Hi all!

No, your eyes do not deceive you — we’re back, and we’ve brought a major update with us!

First off, please accept our sincere apologies to anyone who encountered game-breaking bugs that hindered progression. We’ve been hard at work these past few weeks fixing, testing, and also adding new content to the game — as promised. 

[b]Temporarily Removed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reload perk: Currently being reworked along with the shotgun and some upcoming surprises — so it’s temporarily inaccessible.
[*] Vinyl player
[/list]

Here’s a list of issues we’ve addressed:

[b]Issues Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Logic issue after death load: Fixed a major bug where loading the game after dying would break event logic. This was the most time-consuming issue to resolve, and we’re hopeful there are no more occurrences. If you do encounter any logic problems, please let us know — we’ll hotfix it quickly.
[*] Non-16:9 aspect ratio support: This fix addresses issues experienced by users with ultrawide monitors or non-16:9 aspect ratios. Midnight Special runs at a base internal resolution of 240x135, scaled 8x. Ultrawide scaling caused incorrect UI interactions and made parts of the game unplayable. Our temporary fix detects non-standard resolutions and defaults to 1080p Windowed mode on ultrawide setups. We’ll work on a better long-term solution — thanks for your patience!
[*] Mawie logic fixes
[*] Bathroom lighter issue resolved
[*] Typo and dialogue corrections: We’re currently doing a full text/interactions pass for further polish.
[*] Sanity menu not showing after load: Fixed.
[*] Various menu improvements
[*] Other small fixes and improvements
[/list]

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Save System: You can now save the game at any time and from any location. This feature is triggered in the kitchen after the first phone call (interact with the cigarette pack).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/fe74907e0d297ffaff04f8addd4240df881e6553.gif[/img]
[*] New Mechanic – Tina (the doll): Tina now acts as a compass for secrets. She becomes active after the dream sequence, when interacting in Jon’s Room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098144/3a8485df325334f8b5c10dd47554f6d6ca2e8e2a.gif[/img]
[*] Reduced tripping frequency during low Sanity moments
[*] New closeups to clarify the door puzzle: Added new visual cues (e.g., sketches and canvas in Shelly’s Studio).
[*] New diary entries: Additional lore and explanations for mechanics like tripping.
[/list]

Thank you all so much for your patience and support. Feel free to join our Discord or post on the community forums with any issues or questions you may have.

Sincerely,
The Scared Stupid Inc. Team

notes.title: Bug Alert: Item Logic Fails After Load (Fix on the Way!)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We wanted to give you all a quick heads-up about an issue some players have been running into. Right now, if you collect an item and then die or load the game, it can break the logic and prevent that item from reappearing.

Workaround for now: [b]Save your game before collecting any key items.[/b] We know this isn’t ideal, and we’re really sorry for the inconvenience.

To help with this, we’re working on a temporary portable save system that will automatically save your progress after every item pickup. This means that if you die or reload, the collected item will stay collected and the game logic won’t break. It’s a stopgap while we work on a proper, long-term fix for the underlying issue. This autosave workaround will be included in the next update.

Thank you all so much for your patience and for the amazing support you’ve been giving us — it truly means a lot!

notes.title: Midnight Special demo Gameplay
notes.content:
[b]Happy New Year's Eve everyone!
[/b]
✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨❄️✨

What better way to say goodbye to 2024 than with some spine-tingling horror? 😱 Join us as we dive into the eerie world of [b]Midnight Special[/b]! 

Expect thrills, chills, and maybe even a life-sized talking dinosaur (no, you're not losing your mind—yet)! 🦖

Whether you're here for the retro vibes, the creepy mansion mysteries, or just to hang out with us as the clock strikes midnight, we’ve got you covered. ✨👻


🎥Follow our social media accounts to never miss a live stream or event! 🎉
(If you don’t see the live stream window on the store page, please click on the **Community Hub** in the top right corner and go to Broadcasts)

notes.title: New Mechanic Added!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gQHD1xXb3ug;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey guys! 

We've updated the Vinyl Player System. Now, when you find vinyl, you can stop the record player, select it, and enter a QTE. The UI and the system are still a work in progress, but it always makes us happy when we can add another organic reference to the '80s into the story. It's official—we're joining the Satanic Panic.
